Method of Attack: Identified the user’s NetBeans directory, enumerated all the projects, and embedded a malicious payload in project files and build JAR files.
Ensured that every time a NetBeans project was built, it would get executed, further ensuring the malware’s propagation.
Dropped both payload and command and control software components into JAR files of other applications.
Attack Vector: Infected open-source repositories that were cloned and built by developers
Indicators of Compromise: Malware-infected project files in NetBeans directories
Build JAR files containing malicious payloads
